name: Why is electrical coordination critical for basement and garage remodels?

mainEntity.name: Why is electrical coordination critical for basement and garage remodels?

acceptedAnswer.text: Basement finishes, kitchen overhauls, and garage conversions almost always require dedicated electrical coordination because they introduce substantial new power demands. In unfinished basements, sub-trades must run fresh circuits from the main panel for living areas, egress paths, and wet bars before our crew builds out ceilings and drywall. Without coordinated planning between the carpenter framing the soffits and the electrician running conduit, ductwork and lighting paths can easily conflict.
acceptedAnswer.description: Basements and garages require new dedicated circuits and lighting layouts that must be coordinated around framing, ductwork, and ceiling heights.
